# The Portal's example galleries list the grid issues showcase

## Context

On 2026-10-21, Tobi called this a 13.3.0 release blocker: the new grid issues showcase (`examples/grid/issues`, #19761) is missing from the Portal's examples sections. It doesn't need to lead, but it deserves a spot.

Verified on `dev` `33074574a8`: none of the four registries has an entry for `examples/grid/issues`. The registries are `apps/portal/resources/data/examples_{devmode,dist_dev,dist_esm,dist_prod}.json`, with 28, 28, 27 and 28 entries, and 0 hits.

## The Problem

The showcase is the "Try it" target of the 13.3.0 notes. It is the one example that shows all three new grid features (content-sized rows, header menus, the search toolbar) on Neo's own issues. neomjs.com's gallery cannot reach it.

The registries reach the site only inside the npm package; #19425 records that the hourly data sync is gone. So an entry merged after the cut waits for 13.4.0.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Registries:** each is a hand-curated array of `{id, environments, image, name, sourceUrl, url}`, displayed in array order. `url` carries the mode prefix: `examples/…`, `dist/development/…`, `dist/esm/…` or `dist/production/…`.
- **Pinned order:** `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainerController.spec.mjs` pins ids unique per registry (numbering is not aligned across them), the Workstation (id 27) first, and the Dock Choreography Demo (id 28) last among visible entries.
- **Covers:** `Portal.view.examples.List#imageBasePath` serves `image` from `neomjs/pages` main, `resources_pub/website/examples/`. The engine keeps the originals in `apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/`. The 13.2 precedent is #19640 / #19641 plus neomjs/pages#37.
- **Data:** the showcase loads its snapshot by absolute URL (`MainStore.url`, `neomjs/pages` `resources_pub/data/neo_issues.json`), so every dist mode can serve it.

## The Fix

- **Registry entries:** one entry, id 29, in each of the four registries, right after "Buffered Data Grid with 5M cells", next to the other grid demos.
  - name "GitHub Issues Grid", environments `["Desktop", "Mobile"]` (the header menus have a touch path, #19643), image `devmode/grid-issues-13-3.jpg`, sourceUrl `examples/grid/issues`, url with the mode's prefix.
  - The Workstation stays first and the choreography demo stays last.
- **Cover original:** `apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/grid-issues-13-3.jpg`, 1280×720 like the 13.2 covers. It is cropped and scaled from the 13.3.0 notes' real capture of the showcase (`neomjs/pages` `resources_pub/website/release-notes/v13.3.0/grid-issues-dark.png`).
- **Spec arm:** one test in `TabContainerController.spec.mjs`. Every registry lists the showcase once, visible, with its mode's URL, between the Workstation and the choreography demo, and its cover original exists.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Each of the four registries lists `examples/grid/issues` exactly once and visible, with id 29 unique in that registry and the URL for its mode. The Workstation still leads, and the choreography demo stays last.
- [ ] AC-2: The cover original exists at `apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/grid-issues-13-3.jpg` (1280×720), and all four entries name it.
- [ ] AC-3: The spec arm fails on `dev` and passes with the change. The existing registry tests stay green.

## Out of Scope

- The `neomjs/pages` copy of the cover, which needs its own pages issue and PR.
- The deployed read-back on neomjs.com, which rides #19652's Portal acceptance.
- Reordering other entries or retiring old covers.
